 We were finally able to see Josh Petty in uniform after a long return from injury. Petty didn’t waste any time showing the talent that he is and came in and graded the highest with an 82.6. With how porous the offensive line has been, he needs to play as much as possible. Also grading well were QB Grady Adamson, Kevin Roche Jr, Dalen Penson, and Jordan Allen.

 Jonas Duclona was the highest-graded defender for the Yellow Jackets on Saturday, and that is not too surprising. His ability in coverage to make plays and constantly be around the football was apparent. He certainly made a case that he should see the field more. Trae Stevenson Jr, who is a true freshman, continues to prove he deserves more playing time with his 75.0 defensive grade. Taje McCoy and Tae Harris rounded out the top four and were the best graded.

Wilkins has developed a growing digital sports media presence across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X, combining traditional reporting with modern sports content and on-camera analysis.
